scene: You step from the grounded balloon into breezy, sunlit Balloon Fields.
picture: Flat side-view across green turf. On the far left sits a wicker weaver by round baskets. Left of centre rests the striped balloon basket the boy just exited. The boy stands centre in his orange vest. To the right stands a wooden ribbon cart, and on the far right rises a tall mooring ladder.
shown: an old weaver braiding wicker under an awning on the far left
a striped market cart draped in colourful silk spools on the right
a wooden lookout ladder attached to a mooring mast on the far right

variants.scene: Sunset glows over the grassy field as colourful banners flutter in the evening breeze.
You land safely, humming {tune} while fresh country air fills your lungs.
Balloons rest in the quiet meadow beside busy stalls under the purple twilight sky.
